style.label: Art style
style.description: Overall visual style or medium (photoreal, pixel art, Arcane-like painterly, anime...).

mood.label: Mood
mood.description: Emotional tone expressed in visible terms.

composition.label: Composition
composition.description: How elements are arranged inside the frame.

shot-size.label: Shot size
shot-size.description: How much of the subject is in frame (wide, medium, close-up...).

camera-angle.label: Camera angle
camera-angle.description: Where the camera sits relative to the subject.

camera-movement.label: Camera movement
camera-movement.description: How the camera moves during a video shot.

lens.label: Lens & focus
lens.description: Focal length, depth of field, optical character.

subject.label: Subject
subject.description: Who or what is in the shot.

character.label: Character
character.description: Character identity, costume and anchoring blocks.

audio.label: Audio
audio.description: Ambience, SFX, dialogue and music cues for audio-capable models.

method.label: Method / workflow
method.description: Workflows, checklists and techniques (not composed into prompts).
